shellCommands.command:
cd /tmp && rm -rf smoke && mkdir smoke && BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json PORT=3311 node /workspace/src/server.mjs > /tmp/smoke/log 2>&1 &
sleep 1
curl -s -X POST -d 'title=The Left Hand of Darkness&author=Ursula K. Le Guin&notes=winter planet' http://127.0.0.1:3311/books -o /dev/null -w 'add:%{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n'
curl -s -X POST -d 'title=Piranesi&author=Susanna Clarke' http://127.0.0.1:3311/books -o /dev/null -w 'add:%{http_code}\n'
ID=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/tmp/smoke/books.json'))[0].id)")
echo "id=$ID"
curl -s -X POST -d '' "http://127.0.0.1:3311/books/$ID/finish" -o /dev/null -w 'finish:%{http_code}\n'
curl -s "http://127.0.0.1:3311/" | grep -E 'Currently reading|Finished|class="title"|Aug' | sed 's/^ *//'
echo '--- book page ---'
curl -s "http://127.0.0.1:3311/books/$ID" | grep -E '<h1>|byline|pill|textarea' | sed 's/^ *//'
echo '--- restart persistence ---'
kill %1; sleep 0.3
BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json PORT=3312 node /workspace/src/server.mjs > /tmp/smoke/log2 2>&1 &
sleep 1
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3312/ | grep -c 'Left Hand of Darkness'
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'shared link:%{http_code}\n' "http://127.0.0.1:3312/books/$ID"
kill %1
